home.title: Cities, measured the same way
home.lede: One page per city: population, geography, climate, transport, places and history. Every number shows its source, its year and its definition.
home.status: The design and the page structure are in place. City data is added in the next stages.
hero.nameNote: Name shown from the page address. The official Census name is added with the city data.
hero.localTimeReason: The time zone is added with the city data.
photo.missing: Photo not available yet. City photos come from Wikimedia Commons, with author and licence.
na.reason.data: Added with the Census data in a later stage.
highlights.reason: Highlights are added together with their photos and sources.
section.map.title: City map
section.map.desc: Landmarks, neighborhoods and stations inside city limits.
section.map.pending: The map and the city boundary are added in the next stage.
section.people.title: People & economy
section.people.desc: City limits only. Money values state their currency and dollar year.
section.people.pending: Census and American Community Survey data are added in a later stage.
section.climate.title: Climate
section.climate.desc: Monthly climate normals 1991–2020 from the nearest NOAA station, with its distance.
section.climate.pending: Climate normals are added in a later stage.
section.transport.title: Transport
section.transport.pending: Transit data from public GTFS feeds is added in a later stage.
section.history.title: History
section.history.desc: Key dates, each with its source.
section.history.pending: History is added in a later stage, with attribution.
section.compare.title: Compare cities
section.compare.desc: Same definitions for every city: city limits, land area, same period.
section.compare.pending: Comparisons are added once several cities have data.
section.sources.title: Data & sources
section.sources.desc: Where every number on this page comes from.
section.sources.pending: No data is shown on this page yet, so there are no sources to list.
notFound.title: City not found
notFound.text: This address does not match a city page. City pages use the form /city/<state>/<city>, for example /city/ca/<city-name>.
footer.text: City Explorer · early build · every number will show its source, year and definition.
